bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
found="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='\''videobot'\''"' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 62
test "$found" = 1 || exit 80
table="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d videobot -tAc "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='\''public'\'' AND table_name IN ('\''videobot_poll_cursor'\'','\''creator_sessions'\'')"' 2>/dev/null)" || exit 81
test "$table" -ge 1 || exit 82
echo CREATEVDO_POSTGRES_DATABASE=AVAILABLE
echo CREATEVDO_POSTGRES_SCHEMA_TABLES="$table"
